svg.title: The model reads tokens, not letters
svg.desc: Four strings, each drawn as a row of character cells with the tokens that tiktoken's o200k_base encoding splits it into beneath. strawberry: 10 characters, 3 tokens, st, raw and berry. The same word after a space: 11 characters, 1 token. context engineering: 19 characters, 2 tokens, context and engineering with its leading space. tokenisation: 12 characters, 2 tokens, token and isation. The open-box sign marks a space character.
svg.text: The model reads tokens, not letters
Printed by snippets/tokens.py (tiktoken, o200k_base). The sign ␣ marks a space.
tokens, as the model reads them
Inside a sentence, “strawberry” is one token: no single letter of it reaches the model.
